# Provider-independent scenarios: forks, resumes, duplicates, conflicts.

=== fork copies history: the original session keeps the resource
# --fork-session copies tool_use ids into a new session. Same toolu id twice.
session s1 start=10:00
session s2 start=12:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=mcp__supabase__create_project
  created supabase.project value=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
action toolu_a1 session=s2 at=10:10 tool=mcp__supabase__create_project
  created supabase.project value=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
resource supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa name=fork-test created=10:09
expect supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa exact s1 id_in_result

=== fork listed before the original in the input still resolves to the original
session s2 start=12:00
session s1 start=10:00
action toolu_a1 session=s2 at=10:10 tool=Bash
  created vercel.deployment value=dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000010
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=Bash
  created vercel.deployment value=dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000010
resource vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000010 name=fork-example-team.vercel.app created=10:09
expect vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000010 exact s1 id_in_result

=== forked session then creates its own resource
session s1 start=10:00
session s2 start=12:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=Bash
  created vercel.deployment value=dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000011
action toolu_a1 session=s2 at=10:10 tool=Bash
  created vercel.deployment value=dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000011
action toolu_b9 session=s2 at=12:30 tool=Bash
  created vercel.deployment value=dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000012
resource vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000011 name=a-example-team.vercel.app created=10:09
resource vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000012 name=b-example-team.vercel.app created=12:29
expect vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000011 exact s1 id_in_result
expect vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000012 exact s2 id_in_result

=== two different sessions print the same id as created (conflict)
# Two distinct tool calls both claim creation: never pick one.
session s1 start=10:00
session s2 start=11:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=Bash
  created supabase.project value=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=11:10 tool=Bash
  created supabase.project value=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
resource supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa name=dup created=10:09
expect supabase.project:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa unknown

=== resumed session: same session id, later actions
session s1 start=10:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=Bash
  created vercel.deployment value=dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000013
action toolu_a2 session=s1 at=d1/09:00 tool=Bash
  created vercel.deployment value=dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000014
resource vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000013 name=c-example-team.vercel.app created=10:09
resource vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000014 name=d-example-team.vercel.app created=d1/08:58
expect vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000013 exact s1 id_in_result
expect vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000014 exact s1 id_in_result

=== timing alone never attributes
# A resource appears one minute after a session did unrelated work.
session s1 start=10:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=Bash
resource vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000015 name=e-example-team.vercel.app created=10:11
expect vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000015 unknown

=== created identifier of the wrong kind does not match
# A project ref that equals a branch's ref string under a different kind.
session s1 start=10:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=Bash
  created supabase.project value=brchaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
resource supabase.branch:brchaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa name=preview created=10:09
expect supabase.branch:brchaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa unknown
expect-evidence-only supabase.project:brchaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa session=s1

=== evidence-only resource claimed by two sessions
session s1 start=10:00
session s2 start=11:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=mcp__supabase__apply_migration
  created supabase.table value=public.notes container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
action toolu_b1 session=s2 at=11:10 tool=mcp__supabase__apply_migration
  created supabase.table value=public.notes container=projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
expect-evidence-only supabase.table:projaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/public.notes

=== session with no provider actions
session s1 start=10:00
action toolu_a1 session=s1 at=10:10 tool=Edit
resource vercel.project:prj_FAKEproject00000000000009 name=blog account=team_FAKEteam000000000000 created=d-100/10:00
expect vercel.project:prj_FAKEproject00000000000009 unknown

=== action from a session that is not in the session list
# Orphaned action (session record missing). It still attributes by id.
action toolu_a1 session=s9 at=10:10 tool=Bash
  created vercel.deployment value=dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000016
resource vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000016 name=f-example-team.vercel.app created=10:09
expect vercel.deployment:dpl_FAKEdeploy0000000000000016 exact s9 id_in_result
